dataRights.title: Your data and rights
dataRights.subtitle: Under Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law 151/2020.
dataRights.exportBody: We prepare a copy of your data on the platform as a single file. Preparation takes a little time; the download button appears here as soon as it is ready.
dataRights.exportRequest: Request a copy of my data
dataRights.exportExpiryNotice: The file is deleted automatically after 7 days — a complete copy of your account should not stay available forever.
dataRights.exportRequested: Request received. We'll prepare the file and show it here.
dataRights.exportInFlight: You already have a request being prepared.
dataRights.exportFail: Could not send the request. Please try again.
dataRights.exportChildNote: You can also request a copy of the data of children linked to your account.
dataRights.deleteBody: You can request deletion of your account. The platform team reviews the request, then your personal details (name, email, phone, guardian contact) are permanently removed from the account.
dataRights.deleteLedgerNotice: What remains: financial and accounting records (payments, receipts, settlements) — the law requires us to keep them, and they remain without your name or contact details.
dataRights.deleteMinorNotice: Your account is registered as a minor, so a deletion request is made by the guardian linked to your account.
dataRights.deleteConfirmBody: The platform team will review the request. Your account is not deleted at this moment, and you may withdraw the request before it is reviewed.
dataRights.deleteRequested: Deletion request received. You may withdraw it before review.
dataRights.deleteRejected: Your last deletion request was rejected.
dataRights.deleteFail: Could not send the request. Please try again.
